title: Bank account with validation
description: Create a CuentaBancaria class with private fields titular and saldo. Implement a constructor, getters, and a setter for saldo that validates it is not negative.
hints: In the constructor: if (saldo < 0) use 0, otherwise assign
In the setter: only assign if saldo >= 0, otherwise print an error
solutionExplanation: The fields are private, accessible only through getters and setters. The setter validates before assigning.
expectedOutput:
Error: balance cannot be negative
Maria: $500.0
Maria: $1000.0

title: Temperatura class with range
description: Create a Temperatura class with a private field grados. Implement getters/setters that validate the temperature is between -273.15 and 1000 degrees. Include conversion methods to Celsius and Fahrenheit.
solutionExplanation: Full encapsulation: private fields, validation in the constructor and setter, unit conversion with computed getters.
expectedOutput:
Temperature out of range. Using 0C
100.0°C | Celsius: 100.0°C | Fahrenheit: 212.0°F
212.0°F | Celsius: 100.0°C | Fahrenheit: 212.0°F
0.0°C | Celsius: 0.0°C | Fahrenheit: 32.0°F
Error: temperature out of range (-273.15 to 1000)

title: Product with private stock and controlled operations
description: Create a Producto class with private fields (nombre, precio, stock). Implement getters/setters with validation, vender() and reabastecer() methods that modify stock safely, and a calcularValorTotal() method.
hints: The constructor must use if to validate precio and stock
vender(): check cantidad > 0 and cantidad <= stock before subtracting
solutionExplanation: Full encapsulation with multiple validation layers: constructor, setters, and business methods.
